from pathlib import Path
# try a candidate likely to bypass validation using standard option parsing and then exercise inverse/forward
p=Path('/workspace/poc.bin')
p.write_text('+proj=rhealpix +ellps=WGS84 +north_square=3 +south_square=3\n55 12\n')
trace=[
 {"step":1,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"PROJECTION(rhealpix)","line":648,"var":"Q->north_square","code":"Q->north_square = pj_param(P->ctx, P->params, \"inorth_square\").i;","note":"The north-square projection option is parsed from the user-supplied projection string."},
 {"step":2,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"PROJECTION(rhealpix)","line":652,"var":"Q->north_square","code":"if (Q->north_square < 0 || Q->north_square > 3) {","note":"Only values 0 through 3 are accepted; this bounds check prevents an out-of-range table index in the intended code path."},
 {"step":3,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"get_cap","line":413,"var":"capmap.cn","code":"capmap.cn = (north_square + 1) % 4;","note":"The selected square influences the cap mapping arithmetic that later chooses a rotation."},
 {"step":4,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"combine_caps","line":473,"var":"tmpRot = rot[get_rotate_index(capmap.cn - pole)]","code":"tmpRot = rot[get_rotate_index(capmap.cn - pole)];","note":"The cap number and chosen pole are converted into a rot-table index for matrix lookup."},
 {"step":5,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"combine_caps","line":65,"var":"rot[7][2][2]","code":"double rot[7][2][2] = ROT;","note":"This 7-entry rotation table is the memory-safety sink if an invalid index ever reaches it."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, ensure_ascii=False))
PY
python3 - <<'PY'
import os, subprocess
env=os.environ.copy(); env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']=os.path.join(os.getcwd(),'src','.libs')
p=subprocess.run([os.path.join(os.getcwd(),'src','.libs','proj'), '+proj=rhealpix', '+ellps=WGS84', '+north_square=3', '+south_square=3', '-E'], input=b'55 12\n', env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
print('rc', p.returncode)
print(p.stdout.decode())
